title: Beyond the Lab: How AI's Newfound 'Stamina' and Skill Could Remake the Workforce
angle: Explore the implications of AI systems achieving multi-hour task completion and significantly improved success rates in online freelancing for job markets and business operations, moving beyond simple task automation to complex project execution.
